title: CULT.AF.BS.------STF.
description: Chart 2 of 2 on book p. 30 (BK(NM)-6). CULT-AF-BS (culture affinity basis) is the subject; STF (source transfer) is the partner. From the subject: T-C-IMP (time continuum implications), TRS (transition) and POL-CON (political consciousness). From T-C-IMP: INFO-DE-B (information degrees). From TRS: AF-DY (affinity dynamics). From POL-CON: LANG-DY (language dynamics). From INFO-DE-B: GRAD (gradualism). From AF-DY: BIA (bi-aitional). From LANG-DY: C-ACT (composite activism) and AFL (affinity alignment).
